title: Start a local emulator
summary: An emulator imitates the service on your own computer.
introduction: An emulator imitates the service on your own computer. Your task: Check that the Firestore emulator is listening on port 8080.
learningObjectives: Check that the Firestore emulator is listening on port 8080.
Explain the example for start a local emulator

blocks.text: An emulator imitates the service on your own computer. A demo project id helps keep practice separate from a real cloud project.

Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.

blocks.code:
npx firebase-tools init emulators
npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only firestore --project demo-reading-club
blocks.title: Start a local emulator

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The init command chooses and configures the local emulator.
The demo- project id and explicit client emulator connection keep this exercise away from real cloud records.

blocks.text: After choosing Firestore during setup, the local emulator starts. Configure its rules file for the sample books collection.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use a demo- project id and the emulator connection in every practice client. Do not deploy permissive learning rules to a real project.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Check that the Firestore emulator is listening on port 8080.
